name: The Timeless
description: The beating heart of the café featuring restored brass pendulum clocks, warm espresso aromas, and handcrafted mahogany seating for conversations and pauses.
ambiance: Warm amber lighting, soft acoustic piano, gentle café hum

name: Ink & Ember
description: A secluded library alcove wrapped in floor-to-ceiling vintage oak bookshelves, antique brass reading lamps, and deep leather armchairs.
ambiance: Quiet fireplace glow, turn-of-the-page silence, soft rain acoustics

name: The Tranquil Nook
description: A sun-drenched sanctuary bordered by hanging ferns, bonsai ficus, and linen curtain dividers for deep meditation, journaling, and restful pauses.
ambiance: Gentle water fountain trickle, botanical fragrances, natural skylight

name: Retro
description: Step into a golden-era salon with analog turntable listening stations, vintage vinyl records, warm corduroy booths, and classic café favorites.
ambiance: Warm vinyl crackle, classic jazz & soul, warm mustard & walnut tones

name: Tiny Tales
description: Cozy semi-private round tables designed for close friends, romantic dates, and heartfelt catch-ups with shared platters and specialty drinks.
ambiance: Intimate table lamps, soft laughter, shared fondue & dessert carts

name: Echo Booth
description: Ergonomically crafted individual wooden booths with high sound-dampening walls, dedicated task lighting, and integrated charging.
ambiance: Targeted concentration white noise, zero distraction, focused glow
